basis: results_20261112/marker_modules.json (module membership only; no old result imported)
primary_unit: independent embryo or documented independent pooled embryo sample; otherwise descriptive file-level unit only

expression_views.primary: published log1p(CP10k), per-file observed gene axis
expression_views.linear_relative: expm1(published X), interpreted only as relative normalized expression after scale verification
expression_views.cross_file: explicit intersection of observed genes; missing columns never become zero
expression_views.sensitivity: intersection-only renormalization, labeled as a changed estimand

module_rule: Intersect with each file's measured columns; report numerator/denominator; do not compare a score when fewer than 3 measured members or less than one third of the module is covered. This rule applies before viewing P2 values.

comparisons.contrast: T2 heart E9.5 WT versus E10.5 P2 WT
comparisons.strata: original labels, harmonized broad lineage, cardiac-only and available common regions
comparisons.controls: whole sampled field versus common-support labels; original full-axis normalization versus intersection-only sensitivity

comparisons.contrast: each T2 embryo and heart file across z slices
comparisons.controls: within-sample slice center versus edge and neighboring slices

comparisons.contrast: stage/genotype versus documented run or batch
comparisons.controls: design rank and overlap audit before any coefficient

comparisons.contrast: WT T2 heart E8.25_late to E8.75 to E9.5, with E8.5/E10.5 P2 held for later assessment
comparisons.controls: unrelated neuronal and cell-cycle modules; measured coverage; type-restricted versus whole-field trends

comparisons.contrast: T1 RNA and T2 heart at E9.5, and adjacent training/P2 windows where valid
comparisons.strata: common genes and matched broad lineages
comparisons.controls: within-modality ranks/directions; do not compare absolute magnitudes

comparisons.contrast: each E8.75 Gata4 conditional KO replicate versus its documented WT
comparisons.controls: WT-only developmental direction, per-replicate effects, orthogonal residual

comparisons.contrast: one provenance-verified prediction per P2 task versus matched official truth
comparisons.strata: gene/module, broad type, and spatial region where available
comparisons.controls: composition, marginal distribution, joint structure, and position single-factor diagnostics labeled truth-assisted when using P2 truth

effect_statistics: sample-level proportions and module mean of expm1(X); per-gene detection fraction (X>0), positive median, and mean log expression; composition/state symmetric decomposition only on common labels
inference_policy: No biological p-values or confidence intervals without at least two documented independent units per side; cell and slice resampling may be shown only as within-sample sensitivity. BH-FDR separately for predeclared module families when valid replication permits.
changes_after_freeze: Record actual-schema-driven deviations and exploratory analyses in evidence/DEVIATIONS.json; do not silently replace a research question.
